detail.longDescription: I have tons of accounts blocked due to # AI shilling, so it took me a bit to hear about the recent claims of # LLM generated proofs of big conjectures. As someone who has a certain amount of expertise in # mathematics and machine learning, both technically and socially, my take is that this stuff is basically all fake. The goal isn't even really to make money, although lots of famous mathematicians are selling out to these fascist scammers. It's to discourage people from learning how to do math, because if people outside the existing power structure have these skills they can defend themselves and their communities. # NoAI # MachineLearning # fascism # USpol # math
